items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I mean, I worked under his name, but I never heard him play.

ctx.x: You never saw him with a trumpet.

Oh, no. He didn't blow the trumpet. He was a sick man then. Too bad, too, because I always wanted to hear him play. Now, I mean, I wasn't too enthused about it. I mean, I'd just heard that he was a hell of a trumpet player, and naturally you'd like to hear him as much as you can. And to see the man and not to hear him, you know, it's kind of a letdown. But that's the way it was. I mean, I worked under his name, but I never heard him play.
Now, he, as you know, was offered the job to go into the Cotton Club.
